critical_code_review_comments: tax_engine.calculate_general_payment does a defensive two-pass gross-up (lines ~485-493) — good. But it imports services.pricing_manager.gross_up_stripe_fee lazily inside the function. Acceptable, but moving the import to module scope would avoid per-call overhead.
services.pricing_manager.non_vehicle_stripe and calculate_general_payment both implement the same two-pass gross-up; extract a shared helper to avoid drift across engines.

services.pricing_manager.non_vehicle_stripe (lines 259-260) still uses stripe_recovery() (legacy formula) on the SELLER side but gross_up_stripe_fee() on the buyer side — intentional asymmetry, but worth a docstring note so future devs don't 'fix' one side only.

ListingDetailPage.js seller-aware badge block correctly returns null when seller has no bids — but `hasBids` is derived from `listing.bid_count`/`highest_bidder_id`, which are plain-fetch snapshots. If the seller is viewing while a bid lands in real-time, they may need a refresh to see the badge; consider wiring `realtimeBidCount` into hasBids (already in scope at line 499).

payments.py /checkout (line 113) raises 400 when buy_now=true and buy_now_price is missing — good. Consider adding the same guard to the buy-now-checkout endpoint (/buy-now-checkout at line 1242) for consistency.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug 4 RCA: tax_engine.calculate_general_payment was taxing buyer_premium alone. For small hammers (e.g. $1.10), BP=$0.06 → fee_tax rounds to $0.01; Stripe in production actually taxes (BP + stripe_fee) ≈ $0.69 → $0.10 — a silent 10¢ deficit per transaction. Fix (lines 477-493) computes stripe_processing_fee via gross-up, taxes (BP + stripe_fee), and iterates once more so the gross-up also covers the taxes. Bug 6 RCA: legacy stripe_recovery(fees) = fees*0.029 + 0.30 under-recovers by ~3% because Stripe deducts its cut from the FULL charge, not the fees subtotal. gross_up_stripe_fee (pricing_manager line 60) solves this: charge_total = (net + 0.30)/(1-0.029); fee = charge_total - net. Validated live: hammer=$5 → stripe_fee=$0.47 (was $0.30 + tiny %); hammer=$10 → stripe_fee=$0.63. Bug 3 RCA: /checkout previously always used listing.current_price (=highest bid), so clicking 'Buy Now' charged the last bid rather than buy_now_price. Fix (payments.py 113-117) adds buy_now flag to CheckoutRequest and branches to listing.buy_now_price. Validated: schema accepts buy_now:true (non-422) and the branch is unit-testable by code inspection.
